control_device_fabrication: The PCE of the device was increased to 16.698% with an FF of 77.203%, VOC of 1.0099 V and JSC of 21.417 mA/cm². A solution of Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1 at 1.73 mol/L provided the foundational matrix for the perovskite layer. A SAM solution, consisting of Me-4PACz (0.33 mg/mL), was added to facilitate a stable perovskite interface. For the additive-treated cells, MACl (2.5 mg/mL) was added into the perovskite precursor solution.2.5 mg/mL MACl was then added as additive into the precursor solution. Perovskite solution was deposited in two steps, first at 1000 rpm for 10 s and then at 5000 rpm for 30 s. 160 µL CB was dropped on the film at the last 6 s of the spin-coating. Then the films were annealed at 110 °C for 25 min to form the perovskite layer.
target_device_fabrication: By interlinking experimental conditions with device architecture, a perovskite solar cell was meticulously prepared, affirming a PCE of 18.178%, FF of 84.608%, Voc of 0.97906 V, and Jsc of 21.945 mA/cm². The 1.73 mol/L perovskite precursor solution with a chemical formula of Cs0.05MA0.16FA0.79I2.9Br0.1. A SAM solution, consisting of Me-4PACz (0.33 mg/mL), was added to facilitate a stable perovskite interface. The addition of MACl (10.0 mg/mL) was then completed. The prepared precursor solution was spin coated at 1000 rpm for 10 s and 5000 rpm for 30 s onto the substrate. During the second step, CB as antisolvent (160 µL) was dropped at the middle of the spinning substrate 6 s prior to the end of the spinning. A post-deposition anneal at 110 °C for 25 min stabilized the absorber layer and enhanced device performance.
